messages.subject: strange error messsage
parts:
When I run a two factor model in either det or abundance in TTD I get the following error message

Error in pinds[2, ] <- c((nAP + 1):(nAP + nDP)) :

I can run single factor models no problem, any insights appreciated.

messages.author: 4f80e1927b0757cb
messages.subject: Re: strange error messsage
parts:
I assume you are talking about nmixTTD specifically.

What version of unmarked are you using? This was a bug that should be fixed in the latest version on CRAN (1.2.5). If you're not on the latest version, install that and try again.

Ken
